Process Description:
To ensure local regulations of Australia and New Zealand is complied with, CMA CGM offers our customers the option to fumigated their containers which fall within the scope of these restrictions. When the customers opts to fumigate using CMA CGM services then the containers are rerouted to transhipment hubs of Malaysia/Singapore where authorized vendors are contracted to perform the fumigations. The tasks are broadly categorized as follows:

1. Execution of customer instruction: execution on mandatory operational procedure of fumigation for AU & NZ bound shipments.
2. Transit management: ensuring container rerouting to Malaysia/Singapore and subseqeuent journey legs connected to final POD
3. Vendor’s coordination: appointment of vendor and negotiation of total cost of fumigation.
4. Cost handling: consolidated cost approval, inclusive of rerouting costs, to be validated through customer.
5. Document exchange: providing fumigation certificate & survey report to the customer for customs clearance in AU/NZ.
